tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find businesses and places in Poland by name or type, optionally in a city and category. Returns up to 20 results with address, today's opening hours, coordinates and a cityon.pl link. Use for questions like "pizzeria in Kraków", "Biedronka Gdańsk", "locksmith Poznań". Szukaj firm i miejsc w Polsce

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Full details of one business: categories, address, coordinates, opening hours for each weekday, website and social links, rating from cityon.pl reviews, phone number when the owner allows it, cityon.pl link. Pass the id or slug from search_businesses, or a cityon.pl/miejsce/... link. Pełne dane jedn

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List business categories with the number of businesses: in a given city, or the largest ones in Poland. Each category has a slug for search_businesses and nearby, and a cityon.pl link to the category page. Lista kategorii firm z liczbą firm: w danym mieście albo największe w Polsce. Każda kategoria

tools.name: nearby
tools.description: Find the closest businesses around a point in Poland, optionally of one category, within a radius up to 10 km. Results are sorted by distance and include distance in meters and a cityon.pl link. Najbliższe firmy wokół punktu w Polsce, opcjonalnie z jednej kategorii, w promieniu do 10 km. Wyniki od n

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search real estate listings in a Polish city or around it: apartments, houses, plots (building, agricultural and other land), commercial premises (shops, offices, services), warehouses, garages and rooms, for sale or for rent. cityon.pl has about 70,000 listings from real estate agencies across Pola

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Details of one property: apartment, house, plot, commercial premises or other listing, or a new-build unit. Price, price per m2, area, floor and build year for listings, price history for new builds, investment and developer, price list date, cityon.pl link. Pass the id from search_properties or a c

tools.name: get_property_stats
tools.description: How many real estate listings cityon.pl has right now, by property type (apartment, house, land, commercial, warehouse, garage, room) and transaction (sale or rent), in one city or in all of Poland. Without a city it also lists the cities with the most listings. Includes the number of available unit

tools.name: list_investments
tools.description: New-build housing investments in a Polish city from developer price lists: developer, available units, price range, price per m2 from, area range, completion date, data date and cityon.pl link, plus the city's median asking price per m2. Inwestycje mieszkaniowe w mieście z wykazów deweloperów: dewel

tools.name: get_investment
tools.description: Details of one new-build investment: developer, address, prices, areas, rooms, units available, completion date, website, cityon.pl link and the 10 cheapest available units. Pass the investment link or id from list_investments, search_properties or get_property. Szczegóły inwestycji: deweloper, adre

tools.name: get_apartment_prices
tools.description: Real transaction prices of apartments in a Polish city from notarial deeds (official Price Register, RCN): median price per m2 for all, primary and secondary market, quartiles, median price and area, year over year change, districts, number of transactions and a cityon.pl link. Ceny transakcyjne mie

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_properties" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Apartments or houses for sale in a Polish city, cheapest first, from both markets: the primary market (new builds from statutory developer price lists) and the secondary market (listings). Filter by market, maximum price, area and price per m2. Each result has market, source, price, price per m2, ar" → after: "Search real estate listings in a Polish city or around it: apartments, houses, plots (building, agricultural and other land), commercial premises (shops, offices, services), warehouses, garages and rooms, for sale or for rent. cityon.pl has about 70,000 listings from real estate agencies across Pola"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
